description.en: India, officially the Republic of India, is a federal republic located in South Asia. Bordered by the Himalayas to the north and the Indian Ocean to the south, it is the most populous country in the world. Renowned for its ancient civilization, rich religious diversity, and vibrant cultures, India also stands as one of the fastest-growing major economies globally.
description.zh: India是位於南亞的聯邦共和國，北接喜馬拉雅山脈，南臨印度洋，是世界人口最多的國家之一。印度擁有悠久文明歷史、多元民族與宗教文化，同時也是全球成長速度最快的大型經濟體之一。

seoText.en: Explore quick facts about India — population, land area, capital city, and a short overview. Discover its diverse geography, information technology industry, ancient heritage, and iconic landmarks like the Taj Mahal.
seoText.zh: 快速了解印度的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。探索其多樣的地理環境、資訊科技產業、古老文化遺產以及泰姬瑪哈陵等著名地標。

list: Federal republic located in South Asia
One of the most populous countries in the world
Possesses an ancient civilization and diverse cultural heritage
A key emerging global economy
en.text:
With a history tracing back to the ancient Indus Valley Civilization, India has long served as a major center of civilization in Asia. In the modern era, after being ruled by the British Empire, India achieved independence in 1947 and established a democratic republican system.

As a primary emerging global nation, India is expanding rapidly in sectors like information technology, pharmaceuticals, space exploration, and service industries, standing as a critical force in international politics and global supply chains.

list: 位於南亞的聯邦制國家
世界人口最多國家之一
擁有悠久文明與多元文化
全球重要新興經濟體
zh.text:
印度歷史可追溯至古代印度河文明（Indus Valley Civilization），長期為亞洲重要文明中心之一。近代曾受大英帝國（British Empire）統治，1947 年獨立後建立民主共和制度。

作為全球主要新興國家，印度在資訊科技、製藥、太空科技與服務業領域快速發展，同時也是國際政治與全球供應鏈中的重要力量。

list: Situated on the South Asian subcontinent
Himalayan mountain ranges to the north
Expansive fertile plains and highland plateaus
Extensive and winding coastlines
en.text:
Covering approximately 3.28 million square kilometers, India features diverse terrain with the towering Himalayas in the north, the Deccan Plateau in the central region, and the exceptionally fertile Indo-Gangetic Plain in the north.

India is rich in river systems, among which the Ganges holds the deepest religious and cultural significance. To the south, the subcontinent projects into the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal.

list: 位於南亞次大陸
北部為喜馬拉雅山區
擁有廣大平原與高原
海岸線綿長
zh.text:
印度國土面積約 328 萬平方公里，地形多樣，北部有喜馬拉雅山脈（Himalayas），中部為德干高原（Deccan Plateau），北印度則擁有肥沃的印度河-恆河平原（Indo-Gangetic Plain）。

印度河流資源豐富，其中恆河（Ganges）被視為最具宗教與文化意義的重要河川。南部則面向阿拉伯海（Arabian Sea）與孟加拉灣（Bay of Bengal）。

list: Predominantly tropical and monsoon climates
Characterized by high summer temperatures
Rainy seasons heavily influenced by monsoon cycles
Significant climatic variation across regions
en.text:
India's climate is heavily regulated by the monsoon system, with the annual rainy season from June to September being crucial for agriculture and water reserves.

Winters in the north are cooler, with snowfall occurring in high mountain areas, while the south remains hot and humid year-round. Temperatures in some areas can exceed 40°C during peak summer months.

list: 熱帶與季風氣候為主
夏季高溫明顯
雨季受季風影響強烈
地區氣候差異大
zh.text:
印度氣候深受季風系統影響，每年 6 月至 9 月的雨季對農業與水資源極為重要。

北部冬季較涼爽，高山地區會降雪；南部則全年偏熱潮濕。部分地區夏季氣溫可超過 40 度。

list: Population exceeding 1.4 billion
Extremely diverse ethnic and linguistic landscape
Rapidly growing urban population
High proportion of young demographics
en.text:
As one of the world's most populous nations, India possesses a young demographic profile and an enormous workforce.

The country is home to hundreds of languages and dialects, with Hindi and English serving as the primary official administrative languages of the central government. Major metropolitan areas like Mumbai, Delhi, and Bengaluru are experiencing exceptionally rapid growth.

list: 人口超過 14 億
民族與語言極度多元
城市化快速成長
年輕人口比例高
zh.text:
印度為全球人口最多國家之一，人口結構年輕，勞動力規模龐大。

全國擁有數百種語言與方言，其中印地語（Hindi）與英語（English）為中央政府主要行政語言。孟買（Mumbai）、德里（Delhi）與班加羅爾（Bengaluru）等大型城市人口快速增加。

list: A leading global emerging economy
World-renowned information technology sector
High proportion of service-oriented industries
Rapid development in manufacturing and infrastructure
en.text:
India's economy has grown rapidly in recent years, with its information technology and outsourcing services enjoying high global competitiveness. Bengaluru, often dubbed the 'Silicon Valley of India', acts as a major hub for tech conglomerates and startups.

Beyond technology, India continues to expand in pharmaceuticals, financial services, telecommunications, and electronics manufacturing. The government is actively promoting infrastructure projects and manufacturing initiatives to elevate its position in global supply chains.

list: 全球主要新興經濟體
資訊科技產業世界知名
服務業比重高
製造業與基礎建設快速發展
zh.text:
印度經濟近年成長快速，資訊科技與外包服務產業尤其具有全球競爭力。班加羅爾（Bengaluru）被稱為「印度矽谷」，聚集大量科技企業與新創公司。

除科技業外，印度在製藥、金融、電信與電子製造領域也持續擴張. 政府近年積極推動基礎建設與製造業發展，希望提升全球供應鏈地位。

list: Federal parliamentary republic
The largest democracy in the world
Composed of states and union territories
The Prime Minister serves as the head of government
en.text:
India operates under a parliamentary democracy, with the President serving as the ceremonial head of state while the Prime Minister wields the executive authority.

The country is partitioned into multiple states, each possessing significant self-governance. New Delhi serves as the capital and seat of the federal government.

list: 聯邦共和制國家
全球最大民主國家
由多個邦與聯邦屬地組成
總理為政府領導人
zh.text:
印度採議會民主制度，由總統擔任象徵性元首，總理則掌握主要行政權力。

全國由多個邦組成，各邦擁有一定自治權。新德里（New Delhi）為首都與中央政府所在地。

list: Noticeable disparities across social strata
Rapidly expanding middle-class demographic
Abundant talent pool in education and technology
Exceptionally fast-paced urban development
en.text:
India holds a massive middle-class market, though it also deals with wealth disparities and uneven infrastructure distribution.

Its higher education system produces a large pool of engineering and technical talents who are highly active in global markets. Major cities are modernizing rapidly, although urban issues like transport congestion, housing, and pollution remain ongoing challenges.

list: 社會階層差異明顯
中產階級快速擴大
教育與科技人才眾多
都市發展速度極快
zh.text:
印度擁有龐大中產階級市場，同時也存在貧富差距與基礎建設不均等問題。

高等教育與工程人才為印度重要優勢之一，大量科技與醫療人才活躍於全球市場。大型城市近年快速現代化，但交通、住房與污染問題亦持續存在。

list: Exceptionally high religious and cultural diversity
Bollywood cinema wields substantial global influence
Globally popular and distinctive cuisine
Rich and vibrant festival traditions
en.text:
As the birthplace of major world religions including Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, and Sikhism, India's deep spiritual heritage profoundly shapes daily life.

Bollywood stands as one of the world's largest film industries, and Indian cuisine is celebrated worldwide for its complex spices and distinct regional styles. Diwali remains the country's most iconic and widely celebrated traditional festival.

list: 宗教與文化多樣性極高
寶萊塢（Bollywood）具全球影響力
印度料理世界知名
節慶文化豐富
zh.text:
印度為印度教（Hinduism）、佛教（Buddhism）、耆那教（Jainism）與錫克教（Sikhism）等宗教發源地，宗教文化深刻影響社會生活。

寶萊塢（Bollywood）是全球最大電影產業之一，而印度料理也因香料與地域特色在全球廣受歡迎。排燈節（Diwali）則是最具代表性的傳統節慶之一。

list: Escalating population and urban infrastructure pressure
Severe air quality and environmental pollution issues
Accelerating digital and infrastructural transition
Societal debates surrounding religion and class
en.text:
Rapid urbanization in recent years has put strain on transport, housing, and environmental systems. Air quality in major metropolises like Delhi has drawn international attention.

Conversely, India is aggressively pursuing digital payments, e-governance, and technological infrastructure, paving the way for a rapidly expanding digital economy.

list: 人口與城市壓力增加
空氣污染問題嚴重
數位化與基礎建設轉型
宗教與社會議題受到關注
zh.text:
印度近年快速都市化，帶來交通、住房與環境壓力。德里（Delhi）等大型城市空氣污染問題尤其受到國際關注。

另一方面，印度積極推動數位支付、電子政府與科技基礎建設，數位經濟成長快速。

list: New Delhi — Capital and political epicentre
Mumbai — Financial hub and heart of the film industry
Bengaluru — Center for technology, IT, and startups
Taj Mahal — Internationally famous architectural masterpiece
en.text: New Delhi is the political epicenter of India, whereas Mumbai stands as the largest commercial metropolis and entertainment powerhouse. Bengaluru houses a dense concentration of tech giants and outsourcing firms, serving as the technology hub. The Taj Mahal remains India's most iconic World Heritage site and a global architectural marvel.

list: 新德里（New Delhi）—— 首都與政治中心
孟買（Mumbai） —— 金融與電影產業核心
班加羅爾（Bengaluru） —— 科技與新創重鎮
泰姬瑪哈陵（Taj Mahal） —— 世界知名歷史建築
zh.text:
新德里（New Delhi）為印度政治中心，而孟買（Mumbai）則是全國最大商業與娛樂城市。

班加羅爾（Bengaluru）聚集大量科技企業與外包產業，被視為印度科技核心。泰姬瑪哈陵（Taj Mahal）則是印度最具代表性的世界文化遺產之一。

list: A founding and key member of BRICS
An influential member state of the G20
Expanding partnerships with the US and Japan
Rising diplomatic leadership in the Global South
en.text: India has actively elevated its international standing, becoming an influential voice representing the Global South and Asian interests. It is expanding bilateral partnerships with the US, Japan, and European nations in science, security, and supply chains, while maintaining strategic relations with Russia and the Middle East.

list: 金磚國家（BRICS）成員國
二十國集團（G20）重要國家
與美國、日本合作增加
全球南方影響力提升
zh.text:
印度近年積極提升國際影響力，在亞洲與全球南方國家中地位持續上升。

印度與美國、日本及歐洲國家在科技、安全與供應鏈合作增加，同時也維持與俄羅斯、中東等國的關係。

list: Growing technological and economic cooperation
Expanding interactions in semiconductor and electronics sectors
Broadening educational and cultural exchange programs
A key target country of Taiwan's New Southbound Policy
en.text: India and Taiwan have steadily grown their technology, manufacturing, and talent exchanges in recent years. Taiwanese firms are expanding investments in India, revealing substantial cooperation opportunities in semiconductors, electronics manufacturing, and information systems.

list: 科技與經貿合作增加
半導體與電子產業互動成長
教育交流擴大
新南向政策重要對象
zh.text:
印度與台灣近年在科技、製造與人才交流方面合作增加。

台灣企業逐漸擴大在印度投資，雙方於半導體、電子製造與資訊產業具有潛在合作空間。

list: One of the most populous countries in the world
Home to the world's largest democratic system
IT and software services exert deep global influence
Bollywood represents the world's largest cinema output
Cricket holds supreme national and cultural prominence
全球人口最多國家之一
擁有世界最大民主制度
資訊科技產業具全球影響力
寶萊塢（Bollywood）為全球最大電影產業之一
板球文化具有高度代表性

text.en: Taj Mahal — The stunning 17th-century white marble mausoleum in Agra, a symbol of eternal love
text.zh: 泰姬瑪哈陵——位於阿格拉的 17 世紀白色大理石陵墓，世界新七大奇蹟與永恆愛情的象徵

text.en: Spiritual Birthplace — The origin of Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, and Sikhism, deeply shaping Eastern philosophy
text.zh: 宗教發源地——印度教、佛教、耆那教與錫克教的發源地，深刻形塑東方哲學與社會生活

text.en: Bengaluru (Silicon Valley of India) — Global hub of software engineering, tech startups, and IT services
text.zh: 班加羅爾——「印度矽谷」，全球軟體工程、資訊服務外包與科技新創的核心重鎮

text.en: Bollywood — Based in Mumbai, it is the world's largest film industry by movie ticket sales and output
text.zh: 寶萊塢——總部位於孟買，以電影產量與門票銷量計為全球規模最大的電影產業

text.en: Cricket Culture — The absolute premier national sport, uniting millions across the country
text.zh: 板球文化——印度最受國民矚目的體育運動，具備無與倫比的社會凝聚力與商業影響力
